title: Laptop CPU/GPU reveal: verification results
summary: 18 automated tests passed for realistic chip reveal, details, restoration, learning progress, zoom panning and history retention.

changes.detail: Generated realistic uncovered laptop asset, CPU/GPU hotspots and reveal/restore button. Selecting CPU or GPU reveals its cooling layer automatically.
Cooler and battery removal use photographic-style image regions instead of striped teaching tiles. Other simulated removal tiles retain a diagram label with a plain background.
Laptop GPU is now available in the picker, lessons, close-ups and understood progress. CPU/GPU details describe soldered laptop chips instead of desktop socket/card installation.
Saved the exact built-in imagegen prompt and original PNG; embedded an optimized quality-90 JPEG in the offline document.

validation.name: Focused regression and interaction tests
validation.detail: 18 tests passed after final JPEG integration: CPU/GPU reveal and close-ups in en/fr/ar, restore behavior, GPU progress, layers, pan controls and change-history tests.

validation.name: Source lint
validation.detail: Modified utility TypeScript files passed ESLint. The data file is ignored by repository lint configuration but passed TypeScript compilation.

validation.name: Generated asset inspection
validation.detail: Visually inspected full generated image and aligned CPU/GPU region coordinates to visible packages. Educational illustration, not verified machine photography.

validation.name: Rendered browser/device validation
validation.detail: Browser inventory empty and in-app browser unavailable. No browser layout, physical phone gestures or live app preview claimed. Not deployed.
